clauses.quoted_text:
4. Price Adjustments
Seller may, at its reasonable discretion, adjust prices to reflect material changes in duties, tariffs, freight, or
similar governmental charges affecting the products. Seller will notify Buyer of any such adjustment. The
parties will cooperate in good faith with respect to any subsequent change in such charges, including any
reduction, and will discuss appropriate adjustments to pricing at that time.
clauses.reasoning: Price adjustments are at Seller's discretion and the clause promises only good-faith discussion of reductions. The text does not decide whether a refund share is owed.
